title: Abies Canadensis
snippet: Mucous membranes are affected by Abies Can. and gastric symptoms are most marked, and a catarrhal condition of the stomach is produced. There are peculiar cravings and chilly sensations that are very characlertistic, especially for women with uterine displacement. Right lung and liver feel small and hard. Gleet. Debility, wants to lie down all the time; skin cold and clammy, hands cold; very faint.

title: Abies Nigra
snippet: A powerful and long-acting remedy, in various forms of disease, whenever the characteristic stomach symptoms are present. Most of the symptoms are associated with the gastric disturbances. In dyspeptic troubles of the aged, with functional heart symptoms; also after tea or tobacco. Constipation.

title: Abrotanum
snippet: A very useful remedy in marasmus, especially of lower extremities only, yet with good appetite. Rheumatism following checked diarrhoea. Metastasis. Ill effects of suppressed conditions, especially in gouty subjects. Tuberculous peritonitis. Exudative pleurisy and other exudative processes. After operation upon the chest for hydrothorax or empyemia, a pressing sensation remains. Metastatic rheumatism. Great weakness after influenza. Aggravation of haemorrhoids when rheumatism improves. Nosebleed and hydrocele in boys.
keynotes: Worse, cold air, checked secretions. Better, motion.

title: Absinthium
snippet: A perfect picture of epileptiform seizure is produced by this drug. Nervous tremors precede attack. Sudden and severe giddiness, delirium with hallucinations and loss of consciousness. Cerebral irritation, hysterical and infantile spasms come within range of this remedy. Poisoning by mushrooms. Chorea. Tremor. Nervousness, excitement, and sleeplessness in children.

title: Acalypha Indica
snippet: A drug having a marked action on the alimentary canal and respiratory organs. It is indicated in incipient phthisis, with hard, racking cough, bloody expectoration, arterial haemorrhage, but no febrile disturbance. Very weak in the morning, gains strength during day. Progressive emaciation. All pathological haemorrhages having notably a morning aggravation.

title: Acetanilidum
snippet: Increased susceptibility to cold. Depresses heart, respiration and blood pressure, lowers temperature. Cyanosis and collapse.

title: Acetic Acid
snippet: This drug produces a condition of profound anaemia, with some dropsical symptoms, great debility, frequent fainting, dyspnoea, weak heart, vomiting, profuse urination and sweat. Haemorrhage from any part. Especially indicated in pale, lean persons, with lax, flabby muscles. Wasting and debility. Acetic acid has the power to liquify albuminous and fibrinous deposits. Epithelial cancer. Sycosis with nodules and formations in the joints. (C. M. Boger.)

title: Aconitum Napellus
snippet: A state of fear, anxiety; anguish of mind and body. Physical and mental restlessness, fright, is the most characteristic manifestation of Aconite. Acute, sudden, and violent invasion, with fever, call for it. Complaints and tension caused by exposure to dry, cold weather, draught of cold air, checked perspiration, also complaints from very hot weather, especially gastro-intestinal disturbances, etc. First remedy in inflammations, inflammatory fevers. Serous membranes and muscular tissues affected markedly. Burning in internal parts; tingling, coldness and numbness. Influenza. Tension of arteries; emotional and physical mental tension explain many symptoms. When prescribing Aconite remember Aconite causes only functional disturbance, no evidence that it can produce tissue change—its action is brief and shows no periodicity. Its sphere is in the beginning of an acute disease and not to be continued after pathological change comes. In Hyperaemia, congestion not after exudation has set in.
keynotes: Better in open air; worse in warm room, in evening and night; worse lying on affected side, from music, from tobacco-smoke, dry, cold winds.

title: Actea Spicata
snippet: Is a rheumatic remedy, especially of the small joints; tearing, tingling pains characterize it. Wrist-rheumatism. Pulsations over whole body, especially liver and renal region. Cardio-vascular spasm.

title: Adonis Vernalis
snippet: A heart medicine, after rheumatism or influenza, where the muscles of the heart are in stage of fatty degeneration, regulating the pulse and increasing the power of contractions of heart, with increased urinary secretions. Valvular affections. Most valuable in cardiac dropsy. Low vitality, with weak heart and slow, pulse. Hydrothorax, ascites.

title: Adrenalin
snippet: The active principle of the medulla of the suprarenal gland, (adrenalium) is employed as a chemical messenger, which speeds up the oxidative metabolism, regulates blood pressure by its action on the sympathetic system. Its action is very prompt. For homeopathic use the 2x to 6x attenuations. Adrenalin or Epinephrin, the active principle of the medulla of the suprarenal gland, is employed as a local astringent and haemostatic and cardiac and vasomotor stimulant. It is indicated in a variety of diseases, such as:—Graves' disease, Goitre, Tabes, Shock, Epistaxis, Albuminuria, Congestion of lungs, Asthma, Hay-fever, and Addison's disease, etc.

title: Aesculus Hippocastanum
snippet: The action of this drug is most marked on the lower bowel, producing engorged haemorrhoidal veins, with characteristic backache, with absence of constipation. Much pain after stool, with burning and prickling. Heart and sacro-iliac joints also seem to be affected. The characteristic backache of Aesculus is in the region of the sacro-iliac joints, which feel as if they would give way. Aesculus is especially indicated in the stasis of the portal system. It has also a marked action on the respiratory organs. In cases of chronic catarrh of the nose, with a sensation of dryness and rawness in the throat.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and on motion. Better in the open air.

title: Aethiops Mercurialis
snippet: This is a very useful remedy in scrofulous conditions, especially in children. It is indicated in skin diseases, such as eczema, especially of the scalp and face. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands and chronic inflammation of the eyes.

title: Aethusa Cynapium
snippet: The characteristic symptoms are related to the brain and the nervous system, with gastro-intestinal disturbance. It is especially indicated in children during dentition and in summer complaints. The child is unable to digest milk, which is vomited in large, sour curds. Great weakness and sleepiness after vomiting or stool. Indigestion of teething children. Inability to think, to fix the attention. Idiocy in children.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and from milk. Better in the open air.

title: Agaricus Muscarius
snippet: This remedy has a marked action on the nervous system, producing a variety of symptoms, such as twitching, jerking, and trembling. It is especially indicated in cases of chorea and other nervous disorders. It is also useful in skin diseases, such as chilblains, with much itching and burning. There is a general sensitiveness to cold air.
keynotes: Worse from cold air and after eating. Better from gentle motion.

title: Agave Americana
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of scurvy, with much weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of dropsy and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general soreness and tenderness of the body.

title: Agnus Castus
snippet: The most effective use of Agnus is in cases of sexual debility and loss of sexual power. It is indicated in both sexes for these conditions. There is a general lack of vital force, with coldness of the body. Premature old age.

title: Agraphis Nutans
snippet: This is a very useful remedy in cases of catarrhal conditions, especially of the nose and throat. It is indicated in children with enlarged tonsils and adenoids. There is a general tendency to take cold easily.

title: Ailanthus Glandulosa
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of malignant diseases, especially of the throat. It is useful in cases of low-grade fevers, with extreme debility and a tendency to a typhoid state. The patient is dull, confused, and may be semi-conscious. There is a general foulness of all secretions.
keynotes: Worse from motion and in the morning.

title: Aletris Farinosa
snippet: This remedy is especially indicated in cases of extreme debility and lack of vital force, particularly in women. It is useful in cases of anaemia and digestive disorders. There is a general feeling of weariness and exhaustion. It is often called 'the china of the uterine organs.'

title: Alfalfa
snippet: This remedy is a great fat producer and is indicated in cases of malnutrition and lack of appetite. It is useful in cases of anaemia and general debility. It increases the quantity and quality of milk in nursing mothers. There is a general feeling of well-being and improved digestion.

title: Alkekengi
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of urinary disorders, especially those related to the bladder and kidneys. It is useful in cases of dropsy and chronic inflammation of the urinary tract. There is a general feeling of soreness and tenderness in the renal region.

title: Allium Cepa
snippet: A remedy for acute catarrh, with increased secretions from the nose and eyes. It is indicated in cases of hay-fever and common cold. The characteristic symptom is a profuse, acrid nasal discharge and a profuse, bland lacrimation. There is a general feeling of heat and burning.
keynotes: Worse in a warm room and in the evening. Better in the open air.

title: Allium Sativum
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of digestive and respiratory disorders. It is useful in cases of dyspepsia and chronic cough. The patient is often a great meat-eater. There is a general feeling of heaviness and fullness.

title: Alnus Serrulata
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of skin diseases and glandular disorders. It is useful in cases of eczema and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general tendency to enlarged glands and a feeling of debility.

title: Aloe Socotrina
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general feeling of heaviness and congestion, especially in the portal system and the rectum. It is useful in cases of haemorrhoids and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general lack of control over the anal sphincter. The patient is often a large, phlegmatic person. There is a marked tendency to portal congestion.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and in hot weather. Better from cold applications and in the open air.

title: Alstonia Scholaris
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of malarial conditions and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic diarrhoea and dysentery. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of low-grade fevers.

title: Alumen
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general tendency to hardening and contraction of the tissues. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. It is also useful in cases of malignant diseases and tumors.

title: Alumina
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general sluggishness and lack of vital force. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. The patient is often a thin, dry person. There is a marked tendency to paralysis and loss of control over the muscles.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and from dry food. Better from open air and moderate motion.

title: Alumina Silicata
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of respiratory and digestive disorders. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of skin diseases.

title: Ambra Grisea
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general nervous hypersensitivity and a feeling of embarrassment and shyness. It is useful in cases of nervous disorders and digestive disturbances in elderly people. There is a general feeling of weakness and lack of vital force. The patient is often a thin, nervous person. There is a marked tendency to premature old age.
keynotes: Worse in the presence of others and in the morning. Better from open air and cold food.

title: Ambrosia Artemisiaefolia
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its marked action on the mucous membranes of the nose and eyes. It is especially indicated in cases of hay-fever and common cold. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. The characteristic symptom is a profuse, watery nasal discharge and a profuse lacrimation.

title: Ammoniacum Gummi
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the respiratory organs and the eyes. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. The patient is often an elderly person with chronic respiratory issues.

title: Ammonium Benzoicum
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of urinary disorders, especially those related to the kidneys. It is useful in cases of dropsy and albuminuria. There is a general feeling of heaviness and soreness in the renal region. It is also useful in cases of gout and rheumatism.

title: Ammonium Bromatum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the respiratory organs and the nervous system. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic cough. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of nervous disorders, such as epilepsy and hysteria.

title: Ammonium Carbonicum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general lack of vital force and a tendency to decomposition. It is useful in cases of extreme debility, particularly in people with a sedentary lifestyle. There is a general feeling of heaviness and tiredness. The patient is often a stout, elderly person. There is a marked tendency to haemorrhages and a feeling of chilliness.
keynotes: Worse from cold air and in the morning. Better from warmth and in the open air.

title: Ammonium Causticum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its powerful action on the mucous membranes, producing intense irritation and burning. It is especially indicated in cases of acute respiratory disorders and severe inflammation of the throat. There is a general feeling of suffocation and a marked tendency to cardiac and respiratory failure.

title: Ammonium Iodatum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the glandular system and the respiratory organs. It is useful in cases of enlarged glands and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of chronic bronchitis and syphilis.

title: Ammonium Muriaticum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the mucous membranes and the liver. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the respiratory organs. There is a general feeling of heaviness and soreness in the liver region. The patient is often a stout person with a sedentary lifestyle. There is a marked tendency to portal congestion and a feeling of chilliness.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and from cold air. Better from open air and moderate motion.

title: Ammonium Phosphoricum
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of metabolic disorders and respiratory issues. It is useful in cases of gout and rheumatism, especially when there is a tendency to deposits in the joints. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of chronic bronchitis.

title: Ammonium Picratum
snippet: This remedy is indicated in cases of nervous disorders and fevers. It is useful in cases of malarial conditions and neuralgic pains. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of headaches and mental fatigue.

title: Ammonium Valerianicum
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the nervous system. It is especially useful in cases of nervous disorders and hysteria. There is a general feeling of agitation and restlessness. It is also useful in cases of headaches and insomnia in nervous people.

title: Ammonium Vanadium
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the metabolic processes and the respiratory organs. It is useful in cases of chronic wasting diseases and chronic respiratory disorders. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of anemia and malnutrition.

title: Amygdalus Persica
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the digestive system, especially the stomach. It is useful in cases of nausea and vomiting, particularly that related to pregnancy. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning in the stomach. It is also useful in cases of morning sickness.

title: Amyl Nitrite
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its powerful action on the circulatory system, producing rapid and intense flushing and heat. It is especially indicated in cases of angina pectoris and flushing during menopause. There is a general feeling of fullness and throbbing in the head and heart. The characteristic symptom is a sudden flushing of the face and upper part of the body.
keynotes: Worse from motion and in a warm room. Better from open air and cold applications.

title: Anacardium Occidentale
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the digestive system. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands.

title: Anacardium Orientale
snippet: This remedy is characterized by a general state of mental and physical debility, with a marked loss of memory and a feeling of being divided into two personalities. It is useful in cases of nervous exhaustion and digestive disturbances. The characteristic symptom is a feeling of a plug in various parts of the body and a marked improvement of symptoms from eating.
keynotes: Worse in the morning and from mental labor. Better while eating and after eating.

title: Anagallis Arvensis
snippet: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the mind. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and mental disturbances. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands and gout.
